internet_gateway_id.description: The internet gateway's ID, or null.

egress_rules.description: Outbound rules by name, the same way as ingress_rules.

gateway_endpoints.description: Gateway endpoints (s3, dynamodb) by name, and the route tables they're added to.

ingress_rules.description: Inbound rules by name. Each allows a CIDR block or another of these security groups.

interface_endpoints.description: Interface endpoints by name, with their subnets and security groups.

internet_gateway.description: The internet gateway's name, or null for none.

name_prefix.description: Goes in front of every Name tag and security group name.

nat_gateways.description: NAT gateways by name, each in a public subnet, with an Elastic IP.

route_tables.description: Route tables by name. Public ones route 0.0.0.0/0 to the internet gateway, private ones to a NAT gateway.

subnets.description: Subnets by name. az is the zone letter, like a. route_table is a key of route_tables.

tags.description: Tags for every resource, on top of its Name tag.

vpc.description: The VPC: its name, CIDR block, and whether instances get DNS hostnames.

name_prefix.description: Goes in front of every Name tag and security group name.

region.description: The region to build in. The design was drawn for the one in terraform.tfvars.
